headline: Pacquiao, billionaire Razon join hands to tackle brownouts
summary: Ignite Power, a venture backed by Manny Pacquiao and billionaire Razon, has won key backing to modernise the power distribution network. The project aims to address brownouts.
why: Power distribution networks determine electricity reliability for households and industry in the Philippines. Private investment in grid modernisation is a growing theme in emerging markets.
